info.title: OpenPVMapper Public Data API
info.description: Public, read-only registry of georeferenced photovoltaic installation detections in metropolitan France (mainland + Corsica), served by PostgREST over Supabase. Model-derived attributes (surface, kwp, tilt, azimuth, frpv_proba) are estimates, not surveyed measurements. Estimated pipeline recall is ~0.6: absence of a detection is not evidence of absence of an installation. Data licensed CC BY 4.0 — attribute as 'DeepPVMapper — Gabriel Kasmi' with a link to https://deeppvmapper.fr.

get.description: Returns records from the DeepPVMapper detection registry, with PostgREST-style filtering, column selection, ordering and pagination. Use explicit 'select' and pagination for large queries; prefer the spatial endpoints for geographic extraction with geometry returned as GeoJSON.

parameters.name: insee
parameters.description: Filter on INSEE commune code, e.g. 'eq.33063'.

parameters.name: kwp
parameters.description: Filter on estimated capacity in kWp, e.g. 'gt.9'.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Filter on estimated PV array surface in m2, e.g. 'gt.20'.

parameters.name: tilt
parameters.description: Filter on estimated tilt in degrees.

parameters.name: azimuth
parameters.description: Filter on estimated azimuth in degrees, clockwise from true north.

parameters.name: first_seen
parameters.description: Filter on earliest imagery vintage year, e.g. 'gte.2020'.

parameters.name: last_seen
parameters.description: Filter on most recent imagery vintage year.

parameters.name: n_vintages
parameters.description: Filter on number of distinct imagery vintages detecting the installation.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Filter on comma-separated source codes (0=DPVM, 1=FRPV, 2=OSM, 3=manual correction, 4=recall sample), e.g. 'eq.0,1' or 'like.*1*'.

parameters.name: frpv_proba
parameters.description: Filter on FRPV match probability [0,1], nullable. Recommended threshold for a precision/recall balance: 'gte.0.1'.

parameters.name: false_positive
parameters.description: Filter on false-positive flag, nullable boolean, e.g. 'eq.true' or 'is.null'.

parameters.name: rnb_id
parameters.description: Filter on matching RNB building identifier, nullable.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return — always set this explicitly, the registry has ~655k+ rows.

geom.description: Detected PV footprint geometry, EPSG:4326 (polygon or multipolygon)

surface.description: Estimated PV array area (m2, model-derived estimate)

kwp.description: Estimated installed DC capacity (kWp, model-derived estimate)

tilt.description: Estimated panel tilt from horizontal (degrees, estimate)

azimuth.description: Estimated orientation, clockwise from true north (degrees, estimate)

first_seen.description: Earliest imagery vintage year the installation was detected in — observed presence, not installation date

last_seen.description: Most recent imagery vintage year the installation was detected in

n_vintages.description: Number of distinct imagery vintages independently detecting the installation; usable as a persistence/confidence signal

frpv_proba.description: Probability of an FRPV reference-data match, [0,1]. Null means no FRPV comparison was available — NOT a probability of zero.

false_positive.description: False-positive flag. Null means no false-positive status recorded — NOT a confirmed true positive.

rnb_id.description: Matching RNB (Répertoire National des Bâtiments) building identifier, when available

post.summary: Query detections within a geographic bounding box
post.description: Returns detections intersecting a bounding box as a GeoJSON Feature array. Intended primarily for map/viewport queries. Response properties are a reduced attribute set (surface, kwp, year=first_seen) intended for spatial visualization, not full detail.

max_count.description: Maximum number of returned detections. Default 2000.

post.summary: Query detections within an arbitrary GeoJSON geometry
post.description: Returns detections spatially contained within a supplied GeoJSON geometry (exact filtering, unlike the bounding-box endpoint). Useful with administrative boundaries or arbitrary study-area polygons. Response is a GeoJSON Feature array.

zone_geometry.description: GeoJSON Geometry (e.g. Polygon) defining the query zone, WGS84

max_count.description: Maximum number of returned detections. Default 300000.

post.description: Pre-computed aggregate: for each of ~94-96 French départements, the number of detected systems, total estimated capacity, and its capacity rank versus other départements.

post.summary: Département-level system counts and capacity by year
post.description: Pre-computed aggregate: system counts and total capacity broken down by département and first_seen imagery-vintage year.

post.summary: Département-level system counts by detection source
post.description: Pre-computed aggregate: system counts broken down by département and detection source (see the source-code table: 0=DPVM, 1=FRPV, 2=OSM, 3=manual correction, 4=recall sample).
